The October 2026 Pixel Update Bulletin is here, and it’s a bit of a mixed bag for Pixel 11 owners. While we aren't seeing the massive QPR1 update just yet, this month's patch addresses some lingering bugs and performance issues. From fixing virtual keyboard glitches to resolving orientation bugs in the camera app, we break down exactly what this update means for your daily experience.
